title: Agent-R$^2$: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2611.08219v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans. However, current agents still struggle to finish such tasks, where success requires following long-horizon professional workflows, understanding heterogeneous file contexts, and producing usable deliverables under fine-grained requirements. A key bottleneck is the lack of scalable post-training data that reflects real work intent, authentic file environments, and deliverable-level evaluation. To close this gap, we introduce Agent-R$^2$, a $\textbf{r}$eal-source data synthesis framework that scales training data for $\textbf{r}$ealistic productivity work. Instead of relying on manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files, Agent-R$^2$ grounds synthesis throughout the pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced

translated_title: Agent-R²：通过真实来源数据合成扩展智能体以胜任现实生产力工作
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型在智能体推理和工具使用方面取得了快速进展，这让人们对能够从人类手中接管现实生产力工作的智能体充满期待。然而，当前的智能体仍难以完成此类任务——成功完成这些任务需要遵循长周期的专业工作流程、理解异构的文件上下文，并在细粒度的要求下产出可用的交付成果。一个关键瓶颈在于缺乏可扩展的后训练数据，这类数据需要反映真实的工作意图、真实的文件环境以及交付成果级别的评估。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 Agent-R²，一个真实来源数据合成框架，用于为现实生产力工作扩展训练数据。Agent-R² 不依赖人工指定的工作流程或大语言模型生成的文件，而是让整个合成流程建立在真实的职业种子、源自语料库的工作流程证据以及来自网络的真实来源之上。
tldr: 提出 Agent-R² 真实来源数据合成框架，通过以真实职业种子、语料库工作流程证据和网络真实来源为基础来扩展后训练数据，从而提升智能体完成现实生产力工作的能力。
en_tdlr: Agent-R² is a real-source data synthesis framework that scales post-training data for realistic productivity work by grounding the entire synthesis pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced materials.
